svg.text: The engulf moment, trait-dependent: cover → wrap → seal → absorb
Decision #139 direction, designed in #145. Prey hooks above (cyan), predator hooks below (magenta); tier I / II / III values. Diatom prey drawn for the spines.
out of contact = free at once, nothing held
the membrane lies over the prey's centre. No grip.
no trait touches the cover, by design
PREY · break contact · struggle · spines · poison
pseudopods close around the prey. Grip 0.8.
the membrane closes. The prey is carried.
The predator moves freely with its meal inside
× 6 drain → ratio ejects even when sealed
progress bar (the HUD's) — bands are the phases' shares of 1.2 s; every phase halves at mass ratio ≥ 2.5×
wrap: break contact / struggle / spines / poison
at 1.25×: 0.2 s · 0.6 s · 1.2 s at ≥ 2.5×: 0.1 s · 0.3 s · 0.6 s reaction window before the seal at 5× (E11): plain sprint 13 ticks, Cytoskeleton III 17, vs Amoeba III 7

No engulf effect, by design: Ribosome Studs (digests motes, not prey), Chloroplast, Euglena Eyespot, Stentor Trumpet (its aura is outside the membrane). Nucleoid and Nuclear Envelope touch only the payout.
